statistic.E: (change over the latest 12 months or 4 quarters - mean of such changes over 1990-2019 windows with no NBER recession month) / their sd, signed toward the paper's call
statistic.short_history_rule: fewer than 120 monthly (40 quarterly) reference windows: the longest available non-recession history to the window before the latest, flagged own_history

measures.name: Care: jobs and relative pay
measures.paper_call: crowding: care's share of jobs rises faster than usual while its relative pay falls (E on pay, signed down, >= +1)
measures.rival_call: care's jobs and its relative pay both rise (pay E <= -1 signed)
measures.fits_rule: only while care's share of jobs rises faster than usual (jobs E > 0): pay + paper, pay - rival; otherwise neither
measures.transformation: 100*log(CES6500000008/AHETPI): care's relative pay (production workers, education and health), log points

legs_defined.jobs: 100*log(CES6562000001/(PAYEMS-CES6562000001)): care's jobs against all other jobs, log points

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Payroll dispersion across all 2,047 cuts
measures.paper_call: stays above the normal months' 95th percentile without a recession
measures.fits_rule: level >= p95: paper (+); fell below p95 within the window: rival (-, a signed call); below at both ends: rival holds (0, nothing unusual)
measures.transformation: share (%) of all 2,047 two-way cuts of the 12 payroll supersectors whose 12-month relative growth is beyond 2 sd of its own 1990-2019 non-recession distribution

measures.name: Graduates against high-school leavers, unemployment
measures.paper_call: the ratio rises without a recession
measures.rival_call: the ratio falls (the less educated are more cyclical)
measures.fits_rule: + paper; - rival; 0 neither. Judged in recession windows too (the rival's sharpest call)
measures.transformation: 100*log(3-month avg LNS14027662 / 3-month avg LNS14027660), log points

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Software postings against all postings
measures.rival_name: the 2022 over-hiring and the R&D-expensing rule (restored July 2025)
measures.fits_rule: + paper; - rival; 0 neither. History from 2020: benchmark is its own history to the window before the latest (flagged); reported beside the count, not in it
measures.transformation: 100*log(monthly mean IHLIDXUSTPSOFTDEVE / monthly mean IHLIDXUS), complete months, log points

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Hiring against what unemployment implies
measures.paper_call: stays below the fit (or falls further)
measures.rival_call: the gap closes within four quarters of rate cuts
measures.fits_rule: + paper; 0 with the gap below zero paper (stays below); - rival only when the window holds a rate cut (the fed funds target at its end at least 50 bp below its level 12 months earlier), otherwise neither; 0 at or above zero neither
measures.transformation: JTSHIR minus its 2001-2019 least-squares fit on UNRATE (coefficients frozen at the freeze), percentage points

measures.name: Output per hour
measures.paper_call: grows faster than its usual range (E >= +1)
measures.rival_call: hours slow while output per hour grows at its usual pace

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Labour's share of corporate value added, adjusted for the unemployment rate
measures.rival_call: moves only with unemployment (rises when it is low)
measures.fits_rule: + paper; 0 rival (nothing unusual); - neither. Judged in recession windows too
measures.transformation: 100*A460RC1Q027SBEA/A455RC1Q027SBEA minus its 1948-2019 least-squares fit on the level of UNRATE (quarterly mean; coefficients frozen at the freeze), points. Over a year the adjustment is small (the unemployment rate moves little); the raw share's E is reported beside it

measures.name: Dividends and interest against pay
measures.paper_call: dividends (and rent) rise relative to pay
measures.rival_call: only interest rises relative to pay
measures.fits_rule: dividends + paper; else interest leg E >= +1 rival; else neither

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Transformer prices against finished goods
measures.paper_call: a temporary premium on produced capital: falls back by 2028 as capacity is built
measures.rival_name: lasting scarcity (rents migrating to power equipment)
measures.fits_rule: + paper; - rival; 0 neither; at the second judged window (ending 24 months after the baseline, August 2028 for a baseline in August 2026) the relative price below its baseline level fits the paper, above it the rival

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Land values against pay
measures.rival_call: falls as the real interest rate rises
measures.fits_rule: + paper; - rival only when the 10-year real interest rate (REAINTRATREARAT10Y, quarterly mean) rose over the window, otherwise neither; 0 neither
measures.transformation: 100*log(land / annual pay): land = (BOGZ1FL155035015Q - RCVSHNWBSHNO) + BOGZ1FL105010005Q + BOGZ1FL115010005Q (households' owner-occupied real estate less its structures at current cost, plus business land at market value), pay = quarterly mean W209RC1, log points

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Information technology investment against housing
measures.fits_rule: + paper; - rival only when the window holds a rate cut (as for 5), otherwise neither; 0 neither

thresholds_plain.units: % change of the ratio over the window

measures.name: Saving net of the stock-market wealth effect
measures.paper_call: the residual rises (owners save; the paper's later phase)
measures.rival_call: no residual: saving moves with equity wealth
measures.fits_rule: + paper; 0 rival (nothing unusual) only once measure 11 has turned (its same window reads -), otherwise neither (the paper's call is for after the build-out); - neither
measures.transformation: PSAVERT (quarterly mean) minus its 1960-2019 least-squares fit on household equities / disposable income (BOGZ1LM153064475Q / (1000 * quarterly mean DSPI); coefficients frozen at the freeze), points

combined.count_definition: measures moved the paper's way minus measures moved the other way (counted zones), over the eleven measures with 1990-2019 history; measure 4 is reported beside the count

today.note: the starting point: the rules applied to the latest windows; already seen, not judged

normal_years.rule: 1990-2019 years in which all eleven counted measures exist and no window touches an NBER recession month or a real-time Sahm reading >= 0.5
